notes.title: 💔 Project Update: Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom 💔
notes.content: [p]Today, we have to share some difficult news. After much thought, we’ve made the decision to [b]end development on Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom[/b].[/p][p]This was never an easy choice. We’ve spent countless hours building its world from designing the combat with melee, magic, and shields, to shaping the Witherlings and Rotguards that lurked in the dark. We wanted to give players an atmospheric and challenging experience set deep within a kingdom lost to time.[/p][p]But sometimes, despite the passion and the work, projects don’t make it to the finish line. Between shifting priorities, limited resources, and the realities of development, continuing Labyrinth just isn’t possible.[/p][p]Though it never saw release, this project still means a great deal to us. It helped us grow as developers, try new ideas, and push ourselves further. We’re proud of what was created, even if it won’t reach its full potential.[/p][p]To everyone who supported the project or looked forward to its release [b]thank you[/b]. Your encouragement has meant the world, and it fuels us as we move forward to future projects.[/p][p]The labyrinth may remain unfinished, but its shadows will always be part of our journey.[/p][p]— [i]EvolvedPhoenix Studios[/i][/p]

notes.title: Traders and Quests Update.
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 0.67-A
[/h1]
Hello everyone Today we have a pretty big Update, There are now quests in the game!!!!!

[h2]This is the person you can get quests from.
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336444/147b65a10fcda2ba707252e5a97e8eaa0bffed0d.png[/img]
[h2]This is the W.I.P Quest Giver UI
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336444/cd41a82283bc9a836d6b65d3a54ebdb4e661b5b3.png[/img]
[h2]This is the W.I.P Quest UI
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336444/fe3bfef24336aead708c5e92e7965f9cc21144df.png[/img]

[h2]Also we now have a full inventory system for weapons and Items
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336444/e89ca1e05f7cc2606656859e529534db7f09db0e.png[/img]

[h2]Changes to Traders[/h2]

Traders can now be a quest. What does this mean? it means that if you get a quest called talk to [TRADER NAME] you can go talk to them and you will get the reward for that quest.

There are multiple different types of quests and those would be

[h3]AI QUESTS[/h3]
These quests are bound to specific AI's specified within the quest, Like kill 5 Skeletons will on be triggered by the Skeleton and not another AI like a spider.

[h3]TRADER TALK QUESTS[/h3]
These quests are bound to specific traders. for an example if you have a quest called talk to the Dragon, you will be able to go up to the dragon and talk to him and you will get progress towards that quest.

[h3]TALK QUESTS[/h3]
This is kind of the same thing as the TRADER TALK QUESTS but it doesn't have to be a trader for it to work, I can just be some random NPC that meets the requirements for the quest.

[h3]GATHER QUESTS[/h3]
These quests are ones bound to objects in the world like bushes, crystals, flowers and so on. upon interacting with said objects they will be collected and destroyed for the clients only. so you don't mess up someone else's progress.

[h3]REWARDS FOR QUESTS[/h3]
There are 2 different types of rewards you can get right now, and that is Credits and Weapons/Items
